subject: Yes the git who has played it too!
author: SUFFUR
body:
And as it stands with control options galor, and only playing one map, but all four game load outs, driving the Tank, Quad, and did not have time to sort the controls for the helicopter, but i did get it up, blow up a tank and jump out to leave my other  team mates to die a firey death by another chopper, I would buy this game NOW!

It runs smooth, and I think will be a COD MW2 contender, though I did have a reload problem on the recon load out, a silenced sub machine similar to ODST's sub machine gun.

But a great game, was hoping to see Brink running but I think the session for that was cancelled so hope to catch that tommorrow?

BFBC2 is a great console game and does make BF:1943 look like an arcade game!

And H i think Git is a good achranim?? to me getting to play it before you, lol. But can't wait to squad up with you and the boys and kick the rest of the worlds ass! Yes I said ASS!

Oh and Left 4 Dead 2 was pretty sweet if a bit sick with all the bile and spit flying. And I fubar'd with the Left 4 Dead guy, I said the have we met before? realising he was Inside Xbox just recently, but a great guy, helping people with the game, and being a good enthusiastic for his game.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
